profile.headline: Creative/Administrator
profile.summary: I am primarily a creative who has always had an interest in tech and problem solving. I've always believed in merging my creative skillset with my tactical skillset which is why I studied Theatre and Business Institutions at Northwestern University. From there I went on to create theatre as an actor, playwright and dramaturg as well as facilitate the creation of theatre through my work as an arts administrator in the marketing and artistic departments of various theaters. I have recently transitioned into fostering my interest in data analytics through exploring data visualization tools like Power BI .

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Create and maintain Excel document that tracks monthly firm data including new and closed matters and hours worked
Facilitate communication from clients to appropriate lawyers and paralegals
Implement new programs and technology systems including replacing our phone system, managing our software licenses and troubleshooting minor IT problems

positions.title: Artistic Producer & Coordinator
positions.description:
Liaise between visiting and ensemble artists and departments in the administrative offices including Marketing, Development and Production
Attend rehearsals and production meetings and provide artistic support

positions.title: Artistic and Literary Office Coordinator
positions.description:
Create schedule for and submit payments for post-show moderators and play readers
Gathered and wrote artistic materials for playwrighting awards and grants
Collect headshots and bios from artists for Casting and Marketing
Schedule Artistic Meetings and take minutes

positions.title: Audience Services Associate
positions.description:
Provided customer service over the phone to patrons and subscribers for all general ticketing needs 
Supported fellow associates and managers in facilitating will call 
Received and passed along feedback about Steppenwolf and its productions
Maintained and cleaned patron accounts on Tessitura

positions.title: Marketing Assistant
positions.description:
Created and executed social media plans for shows and compiled them in master calendar 
Procured and communicated with publications for advertising trade agreements 
Researched broker prices of Hamilton tickets and compiled them in a weekly report 
Catalogued articles about shows and company in database

positions.title: Public Relations Aide
positions.description:
Created blog pages providing information to family and educators for website using WordPress
Edited quarterly newsletters and catalogs
Coordinated donor database and subscriber list using Excel and FileMakerPro 
Researched gifted institutions on Pintrest and Twitter and created future posts to increase internet presence
